title: Slim susi-paths, susi-config, susi-core and susi-harness below 10k socket lines
goal: Vision: V-18. Bring Susi core's complete socket strictly below 10,000 physical runtime Rust lines (<= 9,999) under CEO Mandate 84 without dropping capabilities or relocating tests. Delete runtime modules already hosted in susi-commercial-apps (susi-paths-extras, susi-config-runtime, susi-agent-runtime, susi-harness), slim Linux-only foundation helpers to core's actual callers, and update CEO Mandate 84 and lean-core ceilings to 9,999.

reuse.searched: Checked susi-commercial-apps crates susi-paths-extras, susi-config-runtime, susi-agent-runtime and susi-harness, which already own and test all relocated non-core and non-Linux implementations.

limitations: Core targets Linux only per CEO Mandate 84; non-Linux runtime surfaces live in susi-commercial-apps.
progress: 2026-11-18: Applied Linux-only core slimming across susi-paths, susi-config, susi-core and susi-harness and updated Mandate 84 to 9,999.
